last_summary: Trajectory Mapper run 1 (gear 1, free): first Trajectory Note written — navigator/trajectory/2026-09-16-water-as-information-medium.md (ladder: mixed). Separates the line's three conflated claims: (A) anomalous interfacial/EZ water — replicated in existence, contested in interpretation (Elton et al. IJMS 2020: independently reproduced on hydrophilic surfaces, but neutron radiography + birefringence flaws undercut the phase-change reading, Al/Zn replications failed, Schurr's diffusiophoresis is a competing explanation); (B) water-stores-information — attempted and unreplicated under controls (Benveniste 1988 -> Experientia 1992 / Nature 1993 / Ennis 1999 + BBC Horizon null -> DARPA-supervised 2001 null unless a specific experimenter ran the rig -> FASEB 2006 "no replicable effects from digital signals"; Beauvais 2024 attributes it to experimenter-dependence, not water); (C) water-as-biological-information-mechanism — theory only, upgrades 043/044 proposed-but-unrun, experimental leg depends on (A). Tracks the vocabulary drift vital force -> mémoire de l'eau -> living water -> coherence domains -> water memory -> EZ/fourth phase -> active information -> 'information substrate of life', and preserves the three-way ontology split (Ravatin non-physical / Shipov physical torsion / Pitkänen TGD) rather than resolving it. Practicality: EZ test <$50 + microscope (Dossier 009 / quest 2026-09-11), vortex <$30-50 (replication guides 5441/1526), form waves ~$0-10 but the readout itself failed Kassel 1991/Enright 1999, water memory untestable unblinded. Moving question: does blinded EZ width/growth respond to an information-bearing exposure or only to salt/surface/IR/time? Also flagged provenance drift (synthesis cites translation filenames that don't exist; duplicate person-index entries for Del Giudice and Morel). 868 docs under 'Water Structure & Memory' vs 57 under Radionics/Radiesthesia/Shape Power; Yard still has 0 water validations. All 45k files intact on main before push.
